sections.title: The Precise Definition of a Limit

variables.meaning: a function, the rule that assigns to each input x in its domain exactly one output f(x)
the input at which a secant or tangent is taken or a limit is found, the number that x approaches
the slope of the secant line through (a, f(a)) and (x, f(x))
the position of an object moving along a coordinate axis, a function of the time t
the time at which an object moving along a coordinate axis has position s(t)
the average velocity of an object over a time interval [a, t], its change in position divided by the length of the interval
the limit of f(x) as x approaches a, the real number the values f(x) approach
a second function, combined with f by an operation or composed with it
a third function, examined beside f and g
the limit of g(x) as x approaches a
a constant
a positive integer, the power or the index of the root in the power and root laws
a polynomial function
a polynomial function, the denominator of the rational function p(x)/q(x)
an angle in standard position, measured in radians or degrees
a real number between f(a) and f(b), the value the Intermediate Value Theorem says f takes
a number in [a, b] at which f(c) = z
a positive distance from L, the tolerance |f(x) − L| < ε
a positive distance from a, the tolerance 0 < |x − a| < δ
a positive bound that f(x) exceeds near a when its limit is +∞
